title: 2021年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
paperTitle: 2021年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
prompt: Suppose you have just participated in a school project of collecting used books on campus. You are now to write a report about the project, which may include its aim, organizers, participants and activities. You will have 30 minutes to write the report. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: A Report on the Used-Book Collection Last week, a book-collecting project was successfully carried out on our campus, aiming to give idle used books a second life and to help students in need. By gathering textbooks and novels that lay unused on shelves, the project hoped to promote recycling and ease the burden of buying new books. The project was organized by the Student Union, with strong support from the school library. It attracted a wide range of participants: undergraduates from every department, several teachers, and a group of enthusiastic volunteers. Together they set up donation booths, sorted and classified the collected books, and recorded each contribution carefully. Some volunteers also repaired damaged covers and delivered the books to a nearby rural school. Thanks to everyone's effort, more than two thousand books were collected. The activity not only enriched the campus reading atmosphere but also spread the spirit of sharing and thrift among students.
keyPoints: 总览开场并带出目的。"Last week, a book-collecting project was successfully carried out on our campus" 用一句话交代时间、地点与事件，随后 "aiming to give idle used books a second life and to help students in need" 用分词短语接出目的，落实了首段"先总览后点目的"的方法 与 aim 要点。

分点写清组织者参与者活动。"was organized by the Student Union" 被动交代组织者， 冒号后 "undergraduates... several teachers, and a group of... volunteers" 列举参与者，"set up... sorted and classified... and recorded..." 三个过去式动词并列铺开活动，一段之内把三个要点全部 对上。
成果加意义收束。"more than two thousand books were collected" 给出可感知的成 果，"not only enriched... but also spread..." 把意义升一层收尾，呼应首段目的，符合"结尾亮成果收意 义"的蓝图。
